home.title: Home
home.lead: Enter a plot and the seller's name. We look at six sources and tell you what we found, what we could not check, and what to ask next.
home.step1: Enter the plot and the seller.
home.step3: Read the result, then print or share the report.
home.samplesHelp: These plots are made up for the demo.
home.syntheticNote: All data in this prototype is synthetic.

check.title: Enter the plot details
check.intro: Bangla or English digits both work.
check.sample: Fill in with a sample plot
check.fatherHelp: Helps us tell people with the same name apart.
check.consentHelp: This needs your consent. If you do not agree, bank records are skipped and the result says so.
check.loadFailed: We could not load the list of places.

checking.title: Checking the sources…
checking.subtitle: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

result.title: Result
result.loadFailed: We could not load this report.
result.noReportId: Not issued (the record history failed its check)
result.notCheckedHelp: This report does not cover these. Check them yourself or with a lawyer.
result.ledgerOk: Intact. The history has {{height}} entries and matches its signed checkpoint.
result.qrAlt: QR code that opens the verification page for this report

verify.title: Verify a report
verify.lead: Enter the 8-character code printed on a report, or scan its QR code. We check the signature and the record history.
verify.codeHelp: Letters and digits, with or without the dash.
verify.fromLink: Checking the report from the link you opened…
verify.browserValid: Your browser checked the signature itself: valid.
verify.browserInvalid: Your browser checked the signature itself: not valid.
verify.ledgerBroken: The record history failed its check: {{reason}}.

GENUINE_CURRENT.title: Genuine and current
GENUINE_CURRENT.body: This report was issued by this service, is unchanged, and nothing new has been recorded since.

GENUINE_EXPIRED.title: Genuine but expired
GENUINE_EXPIRED.body: This report is ours and unchanged, but it is older than its validity period. Run a new check.

GENUINE_SUPERSEDED.title: Genuine but out of date
GENUINE_SUPERSEDED.body: This report is ours and unchanged, but new records were added after it was issued. Run a new check.

TAMPERED.title: Not genuine
TAMPERED.body: The signature does not match. This report was changed, or it did not come from us. Do not rely on it.

INTEGRITY_ALERT.title: Record history altered
INTEGRITY_ALERT.body: The record history behind this report failed its check. Do not rely on it.

UNKNOWN.title: Report not found
UNKNOWN.body: We have no report with this code. Check the code and try again.

print.title: Printable report
print.hint: Use your browser's print dialog and choose "Save as PDF" to keep a copy.

questions.Q1: Does the seller appear to be the owner?
questions.Q2: Is the chain of ownership consistent?
questions.Q3: Is there a court case or a pending mutation?
questions.Q4: Is the plot on a government khas or vested list?
questions.Q5: Is there a mortgage or a double sale?

ledgerReason.hash_mismatch: a record no longer matches its fingerprint
ledgerReason.link_broken: the chain of entries is broken
ledgerReason.checkpoint_mismatch: the history no longer matches its signed checkpoint
ledgerReason.height_mismatch: entries that the report relied on are missing

GREEN.label: No red flags found
GREEN.summary: No red flags found in the sources we checked. This is not a guarantee.

GREY.label: Not enough checked
GREY.summary: We could not check enough sources to say. Do not treat this as a clear result.

AMBER.label: Needs a closer look
AMBER.summary: We found things that need checking before you pay.

RED.label: Serious problem found
RED.summary: We found a serious problem. Do not pay until a lawyer has looked at it.

INTEGRITY_ALERT.label: Records may have been altered
INTEGRITY_ALERT.summary: The record history failed its integrity check. Do not rely on this result.

R-OWN-01.title: The seller's name does not match the record
R-OWN-01.explain: The name you gave does not match the current holder or holders on the land record.
R-OWN-01.next: Ask the seller for the khatian, NID and proof of how they came to own the plot.

R-OWN-02.title: The seller's name only partly matches
R-OWN-02.explain: The name matches the record only at a {{tier}} level. It may be a spelling difference, or it may be a different person.
R-OWN-02.next: Compare the NID, the father's name and the deed with the record.

R-DISP-01.title: A court case involves this plot
R-DISP-01.explain: Case {{case_ref}} at {{court}} is tied to this plot ({{linkage}}).
R-DISP-01.next: Ask a lawyer to read the case file before you pay anything.

R-DISP-02.title: A court case may involve this plot
R-DISP-02.explain: Case {{case_ref}} names people like the seller but is not tied to this plot number.
R-DISP-02.next: Ask a lawyer to confirm whether the case concerns this plot.

R-DISP-03.title: A mutation (namjari) is pending
R-DISP-03.next: Ask the land office who applied and why, before you pay.

R-RES-01.title: The plot is on a government khas list
R-RES-01.explain: Record {{record_ref}} lists this plot as government khas land.
R-RES-01.next: Do not pay. Ask the Assistant Commissioner (Land) office.

R-RES-02.title: The plot is on the {{list}} list
R-RES-02.explain: Record {{record_ref}} puts this plot on the {{list}} list of government-controlled land.
R-RES-02.next: Do not pay. Ask the Assistant Commissioner (Land) office.

R-LIEN-01.title: A bank mortgage exists
R-LIEN-01.explain: {{bank_name}} holds a registered mortgage ({{lien_ref}}) on this plot.
R-LIEN-01.next: Ask for the bank's release letter before you pay.

R-SALE-01.title: Two sale deeds overlap
R-SALE-01.explain: Deeds {{deed_a}} and {{deed_b}} both sell overlapping land ({{overlap}}).
R-SALE-01.next: Do not pay until a lawyer explains which deed is valid.

R-CHAIN-03.title: The plot area changed between surveys
R-CHAIN-03.explain: The area went from {{from_area}} decimals in the {{from_survey}} to {{to_area}} decimals in the {{to_survey}} ({{drift_pct}}% change).
R-CHAIN-03.next: Ask for a surveyor's measurement and the reason for the change.

R-CHAIN-04.title: The land class changed
R-CHAIN-04.explain: The land class changed from {{from_class}} to {{to_class}}.
R-CHAIN-04.next: Ask which approval allowed the change.

R-INT-01.title: The record history failed its integrity check
R-INT-01.explain: The tamper-evident log broke at entry {{broken_at_seq}}: {{reason}}.
R-INT-01.next: Do not rely on this result. Tell the land office and ask for a fresh certified copy.

R-INT-02.title: {{source}} data is out of date
R-INT-02.explain: The latest data from {{source}} is from {{as_of}}.
R-INT-02.next: Ask that office for a current certified copy.

R-INT-03.title: {{source}} could not be checked
R-INT-03.next: Try again later and ask that office for a certified copy.

R-INFO-01.title: The seller's name matches the record
R-INFO-01.explain: The seller's name strongly matches the current record.
R-INFO-01.next: Still confirm the seller's NID and father's name.

R-INFO-02.title: Ownership history traced
R-INFO-02.next: A lawyer should still read the deeds.

R-INFO-03.title: Date of the last transfer
R-INFO-03.explain: The last recorded transfer was on {{last_transfer_date}}.
R-INFO-03.next: Ask to see that deed and check the people named in it.

R-OWN-03.title: The seller holds less than they are selling
R-OWN-03.explain: The seller holds {{seller_share}} but is selling {{selling_share}}.
R-OWN-03.next: Ask every co-owner to sign the deed.

R-CHAIN-01.title: A link is missing in the chain of ownership
R-CHAIN-01.explain: The records do not show how the plot passed from one owner to the next.
R-CHAIN-01.next: Ask for the deed or inheritance record that fills the gap.

R-CHAIN-02.title: Recorded shares do not add up
R-CHAIN-02.explain: The recorded shares add up to {{share_sum}}, not to 1.
R-CHAIN-02.next: Ask a lawyer to reconcile the shares.

R-RES-03.title: Older records suggest government land
R-RES-03.explain: Record {{record_ref}} suggests this plot may once have been government land.
R-RES-03.next: Ask the Assistant Commissioner (Land) office before you pay.

R-INT-04.title: Two sources disagree
R-INT-04.explain: {{source_a}} and {{source_b}} give conflicting information about this plot.
R-INT-04.next: Ask both offices for certified copies.

fallback.title: Finding {{rule_id}}
fallback.explain: This finding has no description in this version of the app.
fallback.next: Ask a lawyer to review this report.

rules.applicantOther: Someone other than the seller applied.
